messages:
amanda: Heads-up: ACME retest scheduled Wed 10-12 UTC. Need to validate RBAC changes, KMS key rotation evidence, and audit-log exports before they start. Who can own access window + evidence handoff?

raj: I can take RBAC + ephemeral role provisioning. can someone confirm exact resources they need access to (namespace/service names)?

amanda: Thanks Raj. Scope: prod inference cluster (k8s ns: inference-prod), S3 evidence bucket (s3://redwood-pt-evidence/acme-2026), and the private KMS key used for model artifacts (alias/ci/model-key).

lina: Oncall SRE here — I’ll own log export and retention proof. Plan to snapshot CloudTrail + k8s audit for the window. Will upload sha256 manifest to the evidence bucket.

oliver: Re: evidence format — can we standardize on a small manifest like: {type, start, end, sha256, command} so assessors can verify? Also please include the exact KMS key-id and CloudTrail run-id in the manifest.

amanda: Good call. Use that manifest schema and put JSON files under s3://redwood-pt-evidence/acme-2026/manifests/. Naming: <resource>-<start>.json.

raj: For ephemeral RBAC I propose 1hr TTL role with approval TTL 2hr buffer. Example AWS STS command we’ll give assessors (they get ephemeral creds via PR/approval flow):

```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pt-ephemeral-inference --role-session-name acme-retest --duration-seconds 3600
```

We’ll log the ARN and session id in the manifest.

oncall-sre: Can we also provide a small runbook snippet to the assessors for how to request a second hour if needed? want to avoid manual tickets during the window.

amanda: Yes, include a one-liner: "Request extension by creating PR against infra/pt-requests with approvers @raj @lina; auto-grant if both approve within 15m." Put that in the manifest under "extension_procedure".

lina: For audit logs: I'll run these commands and upload outputs (compressed):

```
# cloudtrail export
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --start-time 2026-03-25T10:00:00Z --end-time 2026-03-25T12:00:00Z --query Events > cloudtrail-events.json
gzip cloudtrail-events.json
sha256sum cloudtrail-events.json.gz > cloudtrail-events.sha256
aws s3 cp cloudtrail-events.json.gz s3://redwood-pt-evidence/acme-2026/logs/
aws s3 cp cloudtrail-events.sha256 s3://redwood-pt-evidence/acme-2026/logs/
```

oliver: KMS question: do assessors require proof of key rotation or proof that key is customer-managed? We have a monthly rotation policy for alias/ci/model-key but need to show snapshots.

amanda: Both. Provide: (1) key policy snapshot (JSON), (2) rotation status (true/false + last-rotation timestamp), (3) KMS key metadata export (DescribeKey). Put these in s3://redwood-pt-evidence/acme-2026/kms/.

raj: Quick note on least privilege: The ephemeral role will restrict actions to: GET/PutObject on the evidence bucket path and read-only k8s/view for inference-prod. No key admin perms. We’ll include the role policy in manifests.

security-bot: Ticket created: SEC-PT-4521 (ACME retest — access + evidence). Assigned: raj, lina, amanda. https://jira.redwood.internal/browse/SEC-PT-4521 :white_check_mark:

amanda: Perfect. Next: vuln triage owners — whoever owns the service teams, please assign a single triage lead and put that name in the manifest under "triage_owner". We need that before EOD Mon.

oncall-sre: Assigning triage lead: @oliver will be triage lead for inference-prod.

oliver: Got it — I’ll create a short vuln triage sheet in the repo (security/triage/acme-retest.md) with status columns and link it from the manifest.

lina: One more: for retest verification we should add a tiny smoke test run-id in manifests (k8s pod logs + inference healthcheck, timestamped). I’ll generate logs and include sha.

raj: I’ll prep the IAM grant PR tomorrow morning. amanda — can you confirm we want the ephemeral role to be usable only from our corporate IP ranges?

amanda: Yes restrict to corp IPs and assessor IPs we pre-share. Add that to the role condition and note in manifest under "network_restrictions".

amanda: Ok team — action items: raj = RBAC PR + role policy; lina = audit/log export & smoke test; oliver = triage sheet + manifest links; oncall-sre = monitor window & approve extensions; I will assemble final manifest and close the ticket. Ping here once uploads complete. :thumbsup:

lina: Uploads scheduled for Tue 18:00 UTC. I’ll post the s3 object links here when done.

raj: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/834 (ephemeral role + policy). Marking draft until manifest exists.

amanda: Closing loop — please ensure manifests include exact command lines and sha256s. I’ll do a quick read of PR + manifest Wed 08:00 UTC. Thanks all.

security-bot: Reminder: evidence retention policy requires audit artifacts be retained for 90 days. If assessors need longer, create ticket SEC-PT-4521-EXT.
